tei:div.tei:p: ༈ gleng brjod/ ༄༅/ /kun mkhyen go bo rab 'byams pa bsod nams seng ge'i bka' 'bum pod bcu gsum dang kha skong pod gnyis yod pa'i glog klad yig cha 'di nyid/ bdag cag gi ston pa bka' drin can sku bltams pa'i gnas mchog bkra shis lum bhi'i tshal du/ 7skyabs rje rdo rje 'chang chen po'i phyag btab pa'i gdan sa yang dgon bkra shis rab brtan gling ngam/ 7dpal sa skya pa'i chos brgyud kyi smon lam chen mo'i bsti gnas tshogs khang du/ 7dpal sa skya pa'i smon lam chen mor zhabs sor 'khod pa/ 7dpal sa skya'i khri 'dzin rdo rje 'chang ston 'khor dang / phun pho'i bdag chen rdo rje 'chang dang ston 'khor/ 'khon gdung rnam pa/ ngor klu ldings mkhan chen rin po che/ mkhan po/ bla sprul/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa dge tshul slong / gzhan yang chos ltar spyod pa'i skye bo pho mo 'du 'dzoms rgya cher yod pa skabs dang chabs cig bod rgyal lo 2134 zla ba 10 pa'i tshes 4 phyi lo 2008 zla ba 12 pa'i tshes 1 bzang por/ 7dpal sa skya'i mtho slob kyi mkhan chen rgya mtsho'am bsod nams rgya mtsho mchog nas/ sngon bsags las smon bslu med kyis mtshams sbyar dang / lo nas lo btud 'bad brtson lhur bzhes kyi dka' spyad gnang ba'i bka' bcu dang / slob dpon mthar gson pa'i/ slob ma bslab pa mthar gson gyi phyag khyer stsol bzhes kyi skal bzang gi skabs 'dir/ legs skyes mtshon byed dang / slad kyang mdzad 'phrin gyi cha rkyen du kun mkhyen chen po'i dgongs pa chen po 'phel ba'i ched dang / de bzhin bder gshegs bka' drin gsum ldan gyi rtsa bla gsang chen slob bshad mdzod 'dzin drang srong chen po 7lce btsun 7bco brgyad 7khri chen rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang mkhyen rab legs bshad rgya mtsho mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched dang / 7dpal sa skya pa chen po 'khon brgyud kyi bka' drin bsam bzhin du/ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/

slob bu tha shal pa gu rus sor phyag bcas phul bas dge ba gang thob 'brel tshad don ldan du 'gyur ba'i rgyu ru bsngo'o// //dge'o// //srar yang 2012 lor rgyal spyi'i gzigs pa po yongs kyi gzigs thub phyir/ dpar gzhi glog klad rnying pa kro nis lugs las/ glog klad mtha' ma'i lugs su bsgyur bcos kyi 'od sder du 'grem spel zhus pa'o// ༄༅/ /kun mkhyen go bo rab 'byams pa bsod nams seng ge'i bka' 'bum pod bcu gsum dang kha skong pod gnyis kyi dkar chag bzhugs so// 001 (ka)phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba kun mkhyen bla ma chen po'i gsung 'bum/ dbu shog kun mkhyen bla mar mchod brjod zhal gsungs ma/ kun mkhyen bla ma'i gsung 'bum gyi mtshan grangs dang bzhugs byang mdor bsdus su bkod pa/ 002 (ka)rje bla ma kun mkhyen chen po'i bka' 'bum gyi po ti thog ma'i skabs las bstod tshogs kyi skor/ dpal ldan bla ma rin chen 'byung ldan la gsol ba 'debs pa bsod nams rab rgyas/ rje btsun bla ma kun dga' bzang po la bstod pa bstod dbyangs rgya mtsho rnam par rol pa/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po la bstod pa/ mtshan spel/ rje btsun bla ma mus pa chen po'i rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar chu rgyun/ kha skong / mtshan sel gyi bstod pa rin chen dkon mchog ma/ bdag chen chu mig pa la bstod pa/ kun dga' dbang phyug pa'i bstod pa/ rab 'byams pa shes rab dpal bzang po la bstod pa/ rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas 'phel la bstod pa kā li spel ba/ kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel ba la bstod pa/ mkhas pa gung ru la bstod pa/ dkon mchog rgyal po la bstod pa/ bdag chen blo gros pa la bstod pa/ slob dpon kun dga' 'bum gyi bstod pa/ rje nyid kyi bstod pa khag gnyis/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel la bstod pa/ paṇḍi ta grags pa rdo rje'i bstod pa/ gling smad paṇḍi ta la bstod pa/

karma pa'i bstod pa/ rje rin po che sku skye ba'i drung gi bstod pa/ chu 'dus mkhas btsun pa la bstod pa/ 'chum sde chen gyi mkhan po nam mkha' dpal skyong gi bstod pa/ slob dpon sbyin bzang pa'i bstod pa/ rje nyid kyis bzhengs pa'i gsung ngag brgyud pa'i bris sku'i ngos nas bshus te bris pa'i brgyud 'debs/ kye rdor 'grel pa lugs kyi brgyud pa'i kha skong / bde mchog brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kha skong / gsang 'dus rim lnga'i brgyud 'debs kha skong / phar phyin brgyud 'debs/ tshad ma'i brgyud 'debs/ rgyal tshab byams pa'i bstod pa/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i bstod pa/ chos skyong gi bstod pa bcas bzhugs/ 003 (ka)phar phyin dang tshad ma brgyud pa'i bla ma la mchod bstod rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 004 (ka)rtags 'jug gi ṭīka bzhugs/ 005 (ka)rgyas pa'i bstan bcos tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi rnam par bshad pa kun tu bzang po'i 'od zer bzhugs/ 006 (ka)tshad ma grub pa'i le'u bzhugs/ 007 (ka)mngon sum le'u bzhugs/ 008 (ka)gzhan don le'u bzhugs/ 009 (kha)rgyas pa'i bstan bcos tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi ngag don kun tu bzang po'i nyi ma/ 010 (kha)sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa'i dgongs pa phyin ci ma log par 'grel pa tshad ma rigs pa'i gter gyi don gsal bar byed pa/ rtags kyi 'khor lo gtan la dbab pa la/ 011 (ga)tshad ma rigs pa'i gter gyi dka' ba'i gnas rnam par bshad pa sde bdun rab gsal/ 012 (nga )rab tu byung ba rnams kyi bslab bya nyams su blang ba'i chos 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying po/ 013 (nga )chos mngon pa mdzod kyi bshad thabs kyi man ngag ngo mtshar gsum ldan/ brtsams 'phro can/ 014 (nga )phung khams skye mched kyi rnam gzhag ji snyed shes bya'i sgo 'byed/ 015 (nga )dbu ma rtsa ba'i shes rab kyi rnam par bshad pa yang dag lta ba'i 'od zer/ 016 (ca)rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa zab mo dbu ma'i de kho na nyid spyi'i ngag gis ston pa nges don rab gsal/

017 (ca)lta ba'i shan 'byed theg mchog gnad kyi zla zer/ 018 (ca)dbu ma la 'jug pa'i dkyus kyi sa bcad pa dang gzhung so so'i dka' ba'i gnas la dpyad pa lta ba ngan sel/ 019 (cha)shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i dka' ba'i gnas rnam par bshad pa yum don rab gsal/ 020 (ja) shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon rtogs rgyan gyi gzhung snga phyi'i 'brel dang dka' gnas la dpyad pa sbas don zab mo'i gter gyi kha 'byed/ 021 (ja)'grel pa don gsal gyi ngag don/ 022 (nya)shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi mtshon byed kyi chos rnams kyi yan lag rgyas par bshad pa sbas don rab gsal la/ 023 (nya)zhugs gnas kyi rnam gzhag skyes bu mchog gi gsal byed la/ 024 (nya)mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'i rnam bshad snyoms 'jug rab gsal la/ 025 (nya)rten 'brel gyi rnam par bzhag pa 'khor 'das rab gsal la/ 026 (nya)blo sbyong zhen pa bzhi bral gyi khrid yig zab don gnad kyi lde'u mig 027 (ta)sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba'i rnam bshad rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi dgongs pa gsal ba/ 028 (ta)sdom gsum rab dbye'i spyi don yid bzhin nor bu/ 029 (ta)sdom gsum gyi bstan bcos la dris shing rtsod pa'i lan sdom gsum 'khrul spong / 030 (ta)mdo rgyud kun gyi don bsdus pa snying po yid kyi mun pa rnam par sel ba/ 031 (ta)sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba'i kha skong gzhi lam 'bras gsum gsal bar byed pa'i legs bshad 'od kyi snang ba/ 032 (ta)sdom gsum kha skong gi bsdus don/ 033 (tha)rje btsun bla ma mus pa chen po'i rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar rgya mtsho/ 034 (tha)dris lan pad mo bzhad pa/ nyi zla seng ge'i dris lan/ mdo khams pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan gyis dris lan/

sngags 'chang ratna shrī'i dris lan/ rin chen dpal gyi dris lan/ mus srad pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi dris lan/ sgrub pa khrims bzang po'i dris lan/ ldan ma shes rab seng ge'i dris lan/ bka' bcu pa rin chen byang chub kyi dris lan zla zer bya ba/ ldan ma tshe rgyal skyabs kyi dris lan bcas bzhugs/ 035 (tha)rnal 'byor chen po'i sdom pa'i gnad bye brag tu bshad pa zab don bdud rtsi'i nying khu 'chi ba med pa'i go 'phang sbyin pa la/ 036 (tha)zab don bdud rtsi'i nying khu 'chi ba med pa'i go 'phang sbyin pa'i rnam bshad bdud rtsi spel ba/ 037 (tha)'jig rten dbang phyug gi gzhung bzhi nyams su len tshul/ 038 (tha)yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i brtag pa'i rnam par bshad pa gzhan phan kun khyab/ 039 (tha)kun rig gi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg 040 (tha)bcom ldan 'das kun rig gi cho ga lag tu blang ba'i rim pa gzhan phan 'od zer la rtsod pa spong ba gzhan phan gnod 'joms/ 041 (tha)'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs kun tu bzang po'i nyi 'od/ 042 (tha)'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil chog ye shes rnam rol la/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub dkyil mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i gtor chog phrin las rnam rol/ 043 (tha)dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i phyi rol tshogs bsag gi cho ga maṇḍal la brten te sgrub cing mchod pa/ 044 (tha)gsang ba 'dus pa'i rim pa lnga'i man ngag gi khrid yig zung 'jug gsal ba'i sgron me/ 045 (tha)rdo rje theg pa la log smra tshar gcod pa rigs pa'i mtshon cha/ 046 (da)dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs kun tu bzang po'i nyi 'od kyi don 'grel lam bzang gsal ba'i snang ba/ 047 (da)dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs/ spros med rgyun gyi rnal 'byor/ 048 (da)dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga

049 (da)bde mchog chos 'byung brgyud pa'i rnam thar dang bcas pa/ 050 (da)dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lū nag gnyis kyi sgrub thabs mngal sgong sbyong ba'i tshul/ 051 (da)mkha' spyod sgo 'byed ces bya ba/ 052 (da)dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lū hi pa'i rnam bshad dpag bsam ljon pa/ 053 (na)gsung ngag lam 'bras don bsdus ma'i rnam bshad zab don gnad kyi sgron me/ 054 (na)lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i man ngag gi byung tshul gsung ngag bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyi 'od kha skong dang bcas pa/ 055 (na)dpal kyai rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa man ngag gi snang ba/ 056 (na)kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi mchod gtor gyi rnal 'byor/ mtsho skyes lugs kyi phra mig sambu ṭa'i cho ga'i gsal byed/ dbang chu chen mo'i cho ga'i gsal byed/ rten rnying pa la bya ba'i argha'i cho ga 057 (na)rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma'i mngon dkyil gyi tho yig 058 (na)gur rigs bsdus pa'i sgrub thabs dngos grub rgya mtsho/ rdo rje gur gyi dkyil chog bde chen rgya mtsho/ 059 (na)rab gnas cho ga dge legs rgya mtsho/ 060 (na)mgon po'i srung 'khor/ 061 (na)lam dus kyi dbang bskur ba dang / gso ba dang / bir srung thun mong ma yin pa'i phyag len/ 'di'i nang le'u tshan lnga ste/ lam dus kyi dbang bskur ba/ lam dus kyi dbang gso ba'i phyag len/ rnal 'byor dbang phyung gi srung ba thun mong ma yin pa'i byin rlabs kyi tshul/ rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi byin rlabs/ ga ya dha ra nas brgyud pa'i mgon po dpa' gcig gi rjes gnang bya tshul/ 062 (na)lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pa la yan lag bdun pa 'bul zhing gsol ba gdab pa/ brda dgrol nges pa'i dpal ster/ rgyud kyi tshig don la dogs gcod/ saṃ bu ṭa'i bsdus don tshigs bcad ma/ gzhung ji lta ba bzhin du bkri ba'i lam spyi'i rnam gzhag mngon par byang chub pa'i tshul la nges phye ba/ gzhal yas khang gi chag chad/

kun rig rigs bsdus bde mchog gsang 'dus sogs kyi blos slong gi sbrag sogs kyi khyad par/ 063 (na)snang ba gsum gyi skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i gsal byed/ 064 (na)dpal kyai rdo rje'i sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rgya cher bshad pa bskyed rim gnad kyi zla zer la rtsod pa spong ba gnad kyi gsal byed/ 065 (na)dam tshig dang sdom pa'i rnam gzhag zab don bdud rtsi'i snying po/ 066 (na)dam tshig rnam bshad zab don snying po bsdus pa/ 067 (pa)dpal kye rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi bskyed pa'i rim pa gsal bar bshad pa/ 068 (pa)dpal kyai rdo rje'i lus dkyil gyi rnam par bshad pa bde chen bcud kyi snying po/ 069 (pa)dpal kye rdo rje'i dbang gi chu bo chen mo'i rnam bshad bde chen rgya mtsho/ 070 (pa)rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i lhag pa'i lha spyi'i bsnyen thabs dngos grub bum bzang / 071 (pa)sog po bka' bcu pa/ go bo sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ drung chen kun spangs pa rnams la gdams pa re re bzhugs/ 072 (pa)kun mkhyen bla ma'i gsung 'bum smon lam gyi skor bzhugs so// 073 (pha/ kha skong /) mus chen thugs rje dpal bzang gis mdzad pa/ sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa'i dgongs 'grel tshad ma rig pa'i gter gyi 'grel pa rigs lam rab gsal/ 074 (pha/ kha skong ) kong ston dbang phyug grub kyis mdzad pa/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba'i spyi don legs bshad 'od kyi snang ba tshig don rab gsal/ 075 (ba/ kha skong ) mus chen thugs rje dpal bzang gis mdzad pa/ dam pa'i chos mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel pa gzhung don rab tu gsal ba'i nyi ma/ 076 (ba/ kha skong ) mus chen thugs rje dpal bzang gis mdzad pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi 'grel pa dgongs don rab gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
